hints.title: Constraint Optimization
hints.text: Notice that values in nums are bounded between 1 and 100, which is far smaller than the length of nums.

hints.title: Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count frequencies of numbers 1 to 100. Iterate over all unique triples of values (a, b, c) from 1 to 100.

hints.title: Single Divisor Condition
hints.text: For a triple (a, b, c) with sum S = a + b + c, exactly one of S % a == 0, S % b == 0, S % c == 0 must hold.

hints.title: Triple Frequency Combinatorics

variables: V: number of distinct values (up to 100)
complexity.notes: Counting takes O(n), and testing all combinations of values takes at most 100^3 / 6 steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all triplets of indices takes O(n^3) which fails for n up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V) frequency table allows compact iteration over at most 100 values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes value constraint V <= 100 and iterates values instead of indices.
